title: proxyDeposit reward path transfers aave but deposits arbitrary asset — type confusion causes permanent fund lock when asset != aave
reason: If `pool.deposit` reverts, the whole transaction reverts and the prior `safeTransferFrom` is rolled back; user AAVE is not permanently locked by this path.

title: No token sweep function — ERC20 tokens sent directly to the contract are permanently locked
reason: Primarily an operational/design limitation for unsolicited token transfers, not a concrete exploitable protocol vulnerability from this code.

title: setPool does not emit events for pool or REWARD state changes
reason: Informational observability issue without direct security impact.

title: proxyDeposit allows address(0) recipient — tokens may be burned depending on pool implementation
reason: Heavily dependent on unknown downstream pool behavior and mostly user-self-inflicted; no concrete protocol-level exploit demonstrated from this contract alone.

title: uint128 overflow in amount + REWARD expression causes theoretical DoS for reward-path deposits
reason: Requires extreme privileged misconfiguration near `type(uint128).max`; treated as unrealistic/theoretical rather than a reportable protocol-risk condition.
